prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished complete 16:9 desktop game dialogue screen, 1536x864 or similar landscape, not a browser mockup, not a design presentation sheet. This is the art direction to implement for the Chinese historical narrative strategy game 逆转五丈原, for laptop users at 1366x768.
Reference image 1 is the approved warm charcoal ink thought canvas: carry its refined muted ash/brown palette, airy negative space, small consistent KaiTi Chinese typography, translucent brush-wash surfaces and very restrained cinnabar accent. Do not copy the mind-map nodes or layout into the dialogue screen.
Reference image 2 is the established Wei Yan character identity and costume: faithfully preserve the face, beard, black headcloth, dark lamellar armour and deep red scarf, grounded adult historical realism, do not redesign character.
Reference image 3 is the actual reporting post environment: preserve its military camp tent, banners and distant mountains, soften and grade toward warm charcoal, muted dim grey, no bright right-side light competing with face and words.
Composition: restrained cinematic editorial game UI. Character occupies right third (x~67-93%), face around y30%, enough shoulders visible, integrated through soft ink shadows into existing scene, no portrait card. Scene quietly visible in left and middle upper two thirds. Main speaking area around x8%, y62%, width48%, ending at y86%: speaker name 魏延 with a tiny weathered cinnabar vertical stroke, dialogue below in equal-size small cream KaiTi, accessible 18px equivalent at1366px, compact 1.8 line height. The dialogue surface is a feathered horizontal smoky ink wash with subtle organic silk/paper fibres, no bordered rectangle, no gold corner decorations, no white cards. Name 18px, body18px, auxiliary14px equivalent; use only these two text sizes. All text consistent KaiTi, no brush calligraphy headings and no sans-serif.
Exact text: top-left small chapter marker 六夜 · 传报处. Top-right quiet spaced navigation 思绪  留存  设置  返回. Speaker 魏延. Dialogue 军情有变，我要面见丞相！. A small but clearly clickable narrow cinnabar-coloured button at the bottom-right of this dialogue area says 继续 with a simple fine chevron. No fake content, progress bars, quests, inventories, extra subtitles or extra character lines. A tiny muted footer cue 点击继续 · 空格.
Mood: tense but still, human presence, dignified ancient Chinese literary game, expertly restrained and readable. Avoid office documents, uniform rounded cards, bright blue, glowing gold, ornate fantasy trim, mobile game HUD clutter, giant text, childish watercolor. Output a beautiful production-quality entire UI concept.
